name: Disable Core Parking
description: Sets CPMINCORES to 100% on the active power scheme so Windows never parks a core mid-benchmark.

name: Disable CPU Idle States
description: Sets IDLEDISABLE on the active power scheme, preventing C-state transitions during measurement.

name: Power Plan
description: Switches the active Windows power plan for this scenario. The target plan is chosen from the plans installed on your system when this tweak is added.

name: P-Core Only Affinity
description: Pins cs2.exe to performance cores only (hybrid Intel CPUs), excluding E-cores.

name: Exclude Core 0
description: Excludes physical core 0 (and its SMT sibling) from cs2.exe's affinity mask.

name: Launch Options
description: Edits CS2's launch options for this scenario. Pre-filled with your current launch options when added -- VOIDFRAME only ever adds its own required options on top, it never overwrites what you set.
